def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    ys=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if 5 in row]
    xs=[c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(grid[r][c]==5 for r in range(len(grid)))]
    t,b=min(ys),max(ys)
    l,r=min(xs),max(xs)
    seq=(2,5,0,5)
    for i in range(t+1,b):
        for j in range(l+1,r):
            d=min(i-t,b-i,j-l,r-j)
            out[i][j]=seq[(d-1)%4]
    return out
